description: Declares the complete and authoritative evidence universe for consultant reconciliation. The reconciliation engine must enumerate EVERY registered source. No hidden source lists inside individual functions. If a source is not in this registry, it is not searched — but the registry itself is the declared complete universe.

sources.schema: 17-field buyer package schema (buyer_action_id, problem, buyer, mechanism, evidence_now, modelled_only, known_failures, strongest_alternative, remaining_uncertainty, decisive_experiment, pass_rule, fail_rule, cost_estimate, timeline_estimate, integration_path, regulatory_status, commercial_route, buyer_action, provenance_manifest)

8-axis readiness (TECHNICAL_READINESS, EVIDENCE_READINESS, IP_DILIGENCE_READINESS, MANUFACTURING_READINESS, REGULATORY_READINESS, COMMERCIAL_READINESS, BUYER_READINESS, TRANSFER_READINESS, DERIVED_TRANSFER_POSTURE, VERIFIED_AXES, SUPPORTED_AXES, TOTAL_AXES, BLOCKING_AXES)

contract (hypothesis, test_unit, sample_size, equipment, protocol, variables, control, measurement, acceptance_threshold, falsification_threshold, cost_decomposition, duration_weeks, data_output_format, provenance_requirements, ethical_regulatory_requirements, experiment_type)
buyer maps (package, named_buyers, complete_buyers, decision_grade, buyers[], missing)
claims (package, material_claims[], material_unknowns[], claims_count, unknowns_count, all_claims_have_evidence_class, all_unknowns_have_resolution_plan)
upgraded packages (package_id, name, technology, problem, mechanism, regulatory{}, patent{}, ...)

registry_invariants.supersession_rule: Changes require AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_REGISTRY_V2 with explicit supersession_rationale
